description: This file defines the CredentialStore class which provides an abstraction over credential persistence using SharedPreferences in a Flutter application. It includes methods to load, save, and clear user credentials while respecting user preferences for remembering username and password.

classes.name: CredentialStore
classes.description: A class providing methods to load, save, and clear credentials using SharedPreferences, with consideration for user settings such as 'remember username' and 'remember password'.

methods.name: loadCredentials
methods.description: Loads credentials from SharedPreferences, applying user preferences for remembering username and password.

methods.name: saveCredentials
methods.description: Saves provided credentials into SharedPreferences, respecting the 'remember' flags for username and password.

methods.name: clearCredentials
methods.description: Removes all credential-related data from SharedPreferences, including URL, username, password, and remember flags.
